stt: Ask HN: Recommend resources that helped your game dev journey?
x:
It may be too FPS specific, but I always got a lot out of the in-game audio commentaries on Valve's games (HL2: Episodes, (since 2024) HL2 itself, Portal 2 etc.) There is some great analysis of player psychology in the recordings that I think would be universal across games.

As a game developer myself (hobbyist), I sincerely wish you the best of luck. Games are hard, but they're worth the effort!

(And also for what it's worth, my first forays into game development was met with lots of critical comments (some helpful, some not). It's part of the process, but don't let it discourage you!)
